cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give your prize seat to a volunteer if you're serious about supporting the show. Tell the usher before the doors open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give yours up too? Our seats are next to each other.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine is an observation position. I need a clear view to assess the staging; please distinguish that from attending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then swap with me. Same view, and I'll give yours away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yours hasn't got the padded back. Please check the seat specification before proposing an equivalent; I can't assess three hours of staging while thinking about my spine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 calls own seat an observation post and A5 corrects equivalent-view into comfort specification, using expert staging needs to protect A from the sacrifice demanded of B.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 offer a genuinely reciprocal solution to A's stated view need.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 solution to reveal comfort as the newly protected cost.
